description:
Home Systems Lab reveals the hidden physics that keeps a house comfortable, healthy and durable.
We explain HVAC systems, heat pumps, insulation, ventilation, moisture control, plumbing, drainage, roofing, foundations and residential electrical protection. Each documentary begins with a familiar symptom, follows heat, air, water, vapor or structural load through the building, and identifies the system-level cause.
Every episode uses original research, traceable sources and a distinct thesis. Technical diagrams and illustrative AI reconstructions are distinguished from real evidence. We do not provide individualized inspections, hazardous electrical or gas instructions, medical diagnoses or contractor endorsements.
Subscribe to understand your home as one connected system.
This channel provides general educational information. Consult qualified local professionals and current codes for decisions involving safety, health, structure, gas or electricity.
